execution_flows.purpose: Text-first projector alignment -> richer instruction alignment -> point-language transfer via compact point tokens and shared projector

method_modules.paper_role: inject projected point features into language token stream
load/filter conversation supervision and point samples
convert point placeholders into multimodal training tokens
compact point-token aggregation with neighborhood routing
shared projector from encoder space to LLM hidden space

candidate_mechanisms.name: Stage I: Text-first interface warmup
candidate_mechanisms.description: Establish projector-language coupling under mostly frozen backbone settings.
outputs: stable projector initialization for language conditioning

candidate_mechanisms.name: Stage II: Rich instruction alignment
candidate_mechanisms.description: Expand from simple descriptions to richer instruction/dialog patterns while preserving projector continuity.

candidate_mechanisms.name: Stage III: Point-language transfer
candidate_mechanisms.description: Use point-cloud token features and compact token aggregation to transfer prior alignment to 3D inputs.

candidate_mechanisms.name: Runtime and saving behavior
candidate_mechanisms.description: Control runtime mechanics (trainer save behavior/logging/checkpoint flow).
